Game Overview

In Sweet Candy, the core idea is straightforward: indulge in Sweet Candy's vibrant world where you swap and match colorful treats. It's a deliciously addictive experience as you strategize to align candies vertically or horizontally, sparking delightful chain reactions. Simple yet satisfyingly challenging, this puzzler will capture your sweet tooth and mind alike.
